question: When remove-then-reroute reports no path, can we retain enough bounded evidence to see where the DUT A* search stopped instead of preserving only a sentence and an unchanged board?

retained_grid_fields: blocked-state count and exact row runs
blocked-frontier state count and exact row runs
diagnostic_artifacts: paired top-down front/back PNG when rsvg-convert is available
implementation.transaction_rule: the topology-only candidate is diagnostic data and is never eligible for selection or commit

visual_interpretation.front: the two endpoints lie on opposite sides of dense horizontal and vertical occupied bands; the cyan frontier closes around the reachable upper region
visual_interpretation.back: the reachable region leaves the western endpoint but closes against a diagonal track bundle, pads, and the surrounding occupied field before reaching the eastern endpoint

colors.target_copper: blue on F.Cu and amber on B.Cu

representation_ablation.problem: the fine grid repeated long horizontal boundaries as thousands of JSON coordinate scalars
representation_ablation.correction: lossless deterministic row-run encoding for both occupied cells and frontier cells

worked: the real no-path action now says exactly which grid region and boundary were explored
failed actions retain affected branch identity and their topology-only candidate without making invalid copper selectable
front/back plan views use one coordinate orientation and make the obstruction visible while scrolling
the reduced regression covers both successful repair and a typed no-path wall; the real-board regression checks retained frontier and SVG artifacts
limits: frontier cells are not yet attributed to semantic owners such as a component, foreign net, or movable trace
the diagnostic view draws copper geometry and pads but not full footprint body/silkscreen detail
row-run evidence is lossless and grid-bounded, but worst-case checkerboard occupancy can still approach the configured maximum_grid_states
this is CPU diagnostic evidence, not a GPU implementation or runtime comparison
critical_evaluation.next: classify frontier runs by blocking obstacle owner/net and feed those typed blockers into a replaceable action producer that can choose trace displacement, component movement, via insertion, or retaining the existing excursion
